name: OSV-Scanner Vulnerability Scan

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  # Bump cadence: check https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/releases monthly.
  # Dependabot cannot bump curl-installed binaries — update version + checksum manually.
  OSV_SCANNER_VERSION: "2.5.1"
  OSV_SCANNER_SHA256: "f9f25499a2c8cc367b3af45df2ea7eeca7fbccceab9c35079968f4b3652194be"

jobs:
  source-scan:
    name: Scan source dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # Needed to upload SARIF results to the code scanning dashboard.
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Cache OSV-Scanner binary
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: osv-scanner
          key: osv-scanner-${{ env.OSV_SCANNER_VERSION }}-${{ env.OSV_SCANNER_SHA256 }}

      - name: Install OSV-Scanner
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f osv-scanner ]; then
            ACTUAL_SHA=$(sha256sum osv-scanner | awk '{print $1}')
            if [ "$ACTUAL_SHA" = "$OSV_SCANNER_SHA256" ]; then
              chmod +x osv-scanner
              sudo mv osv-scanner /usr/local/bin/
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/releases/download/v${OSV_SCANNER_VERSION}/osv-scanner_linux_amd64" -o osv-scanner
          ACTUAL_SHA=$(sha256sum osv-scanner | awk '{print $1}')
          if [ "$ACTUAL_SHA" != "$OSV_SCANNER_SHA256" ]; then
            echo "::error::OSV-Scanner checksum mismatch! Expected ${OSV_SCANNER_SHA256}, got ${ACTUAL_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi
          chmod +x osv-scanner
          sudo mv osv-scanner /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Run OSV-Scanner
        # Every manifest OSV-Scanner can parse in this repo is listed here.
        # api/python_api has no lock file, so there is nothing to resolve versions from.
        run: |
          rc=0
          osv-scanner scan source \
            --format sarif \
            --output-file osv-results.sarif \
            -L go.mod \
            -L test/e2e/go.mod \
            -L docs/website/uv.lock || rc=$?
          # Exit code 1 = vulnerabilities found (expected, reported via SARIF), 0 = clean.
          # Any other code is a real failure of the scanner itself.
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::OSV-Scanner failed with unexpected exit code $rc"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload SARIF to GitHub Security tab
        if: always() && hashFiles('osv-results.sarif') != ''
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@1b168cd39490f61582a9beae412bb7057a6b2c4e # v4.31.8
        with:
          sarif_file: osv-results.sarif
          category: kubeflow-spark-operator-osv-scanner", "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads the OSV-Scanner binary via curl on every run. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports caching dependency downloads, with reported modest aggregate benefit (free: 6%, paid: 3.4% VM time reduction). The binary is version- and checksum-pinned via env vars, so the cache key (OSV_SCANNER_VERSION + OSV_SCANNER_SHA256) invalidates correctly on updates. The existing checksum verification is retained before the cached binary is used, preserving security. All three lockfile scans and the SARIF upload remain unchanged, so build/test coverage is preserved.", "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
